samples.stimulus: Researchers compared the driving test scores of drivers who used an online safety course with those of drivers who did not. Details of the study are shown in the table.
samples.question: Which statement about the study is most appropriate?
options: Using an online safety course caused a lower mean driving test score among the participants.
Using an online safety course caused a higher mean driving test score among the participants.
Using an online safety course is associated with a higher mean driving test score, but the study does not show that it caused the difference.
Using an online safety course is associated with a lower mean driving test score, but the study does not show that it caused the difference.
samples.answer: Using an online safety course caused a lower mean driving test score among the participants.
samples.explanation: (1) 처치 결정 방법을 읽는다: 무작위 배정. (2) 무작위 배정이면 두 조건의 다른 차이가 고르게 섞여 인과 결론이 가능하다. (3) 평균: 사용 49, 비사용 71 이다. (4) 사용자 평균이 더 낮다. (5) 따라서 인과 결론 + 해당 방향. 따라서 정답은 A이다.
